user.title: Govee HVAC
user.description: Pick a Govee device found by Home Assistant's Bluetooth (local adapters and Bluetooth proxies).

manual.title: Govee HVAC
manual.description: Enter the device's BLE address (e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF) and model. If you expected it to be found automatically, make sure it's powered on, in range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy, and not connected to the Govee app, then try again.

abort.not_supported: This Govee model is not supported yet.
